english.note: Use this for an internet website, not a physical location.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a website as a collection of web pages.

examples.english: I found that recipe on this site.
examples.traditional: 我喺呢個網站搵到嗰份食譜。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 wan2 dou2 go2 fan6 sik6 pou2

examples.english: This website has lots of travel information.
examples.traditional: 呢個網站有好多旅遊資料。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 jau5 hou2 do1 leoi5 jau4 zi1 liu2
